info.title: API.SH: Lowe's
info.description: The Lowe's API from API.SH: public Lowe's data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A product's price and stock at one Lowe's store: the store's price and savings, in-store quantity and each fulfilment option (pickup, delivery, shipping) with availability, quantity and promise date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lowes-availability

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product number (end of a lowes.com/pd/ link), or use url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: lowes.com/pd/... product link.

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number (from a lowes.com/store/<state>-<city>/<number> link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Drill Set 12-volt 1/4-in Keyless Cordless Drill 1 -Batteries Included, and Charger Included

get.description:
The products of a Lowe's category listing page (a lowes.com/pl/ link), as a visitor without a selected store sees them. Each product: id, item number, model, name, brand, price, was-price and savings, rating, review count, key specs, sponsored and marketplace flags, online availability, link, image and `raw`. Also the total, the category's refinements with counts (`facets`; pass a value's `refinement` back as `refinement`, join several with `+`), the sort menu and breadcrumbs. 24 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lowes-category

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A lowes.com/pl/<name>/<id> category link, or just its numeric id.

parameters.name: refinement
parameters.description: Refinement ids from `facets[].values[].refinement`, joined with `+`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order, as the site's Sort by menu: `featured` (default), `price_low`, `price_high`, `best_selling`, `rating`, `brand` or `newest`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (up to 50). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Lowe's product: title, text, star rating, recommended or not, reviewer nickname, date, verified-purchaser, incentivized, employee and expert flags, helpful and not-helpful votes, photos, videos and replies from the brand or Lowe's. Also the rating summary: average, review count, recommended counts and the count for each star. 10 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lowes-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product number at the end of a lowes.com/pd/ link. Give `id` or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A lowes.com/pd/... product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `newest` (default), `oldest` or `most_helpful`.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Lowe's (US) for keywords, as a visitor without a selected store sees them. Each product: id, item number, model, name, brand, price, was-price, savings and savings end date, rating, review count, key specs, sponsored and marketplace flags, online availability by fulfilment method, link, image and `raw`. `facets` lists the site's refinements with counts; pass a value's `refinement` back as `refinement` (join several with `+`). `sort` orders the results; `sort_options` lists the site's sort menu. Broad terms (e.g. `paint`) open a category page instead of results: the answer then has no items and `redirected_to` names that page. 24 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lowes-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `cordless drill`.

parameters.name: refinement
parameters.description: Refinement ids from `facets[].values[].refinement`, joined with `+`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (up to 50). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order, as the site's Sort by menu: `featured` (default), `price_low`, `price_high`, `best_selling`, `rating`, `brand` or `newest`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

A Lowe's store's details: name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, coordinates and opening hours for the week (with holiday flags), plus the page's full store record.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lowes-store

parameters.name: store
parameters.description: Store number, or a lowes.com/store/<state>-<city>/<number> link (url).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: lowes.com/store/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
